title: Gov Proposal Editor
tagline: Gov Proposal Editor simplifies the proposal submission process leveraging Web3.Storage (IPFS + Filecoin), makes it more adapted to Gov (Governor + ERC-721) and also intends to add a privacy layer thanks to Medusa Network.
description:
We now have great tools to build DAOs, including Open Zeppelin's Governor and Tally. Gov is a DAO template that combines Governor and ERC-721. Tally's UX is pretty remarkable, Gov Proposal Editor simplifies the proposal submission process leveraging Web3.Storage (IPFS + Filecoin), makes it more adapted to Gov and also intends to add a privacy layer thanks to Medusa Network.

The interface allows you to edit and submit a DAO proposal.
how_its_made:
On this project, we're working in Solidity, TypeScript and Next.js. 

We've integrated the following tech components: 

- Gov (OZ's Governor + ERC-721)
- Web3.Storage
- Medusa Network
- Wagmi, ConnectKit and Ethers.js

We're extremely proud of our successful integration of Medusa Network that is used to encrypt certain documents attached to the proposal: these are only accessible to the DAO members. Everything is verifiable and fully decentralized.
